authority: Owner-authorized new Decode delivery goal and first diagnostic protocol; no new runtime mechanism, numerical identity, performance result or production selection.

goal.objective: Improve real-API committed Decode throughput by an additional 25% in stage 1 and an additional 50% in stage 2 versus the frozen installed v127 MTP baseline, independently for caps 2 and 3 in short, 8K and 40K buckets; preserve numerical, state, output, capacity and resource contracts and jointly report Prefill, TTFT, Decode and total time.
goal.authorization: Explicit project-owner acceptance of the staged Decode plan on 2026-10-21; this is a new goal following completed bounded MTP delivery, not a reopening or reinterpretation of its evidence.
goal.coverage: Every cap/bucket must pass; no averaging across caps or context buckets, and no substitution of another prompt/output workload.
goal.completion: Stage 1 is a delivery checkpoint, not completion of stage 2. Completion requires current-state numerical, output, API, resource and exact-installed-artifact evidence for the selected composition plus independent matched performance validation.

baseline.architecture: v127 selected GDN ownership plus startup FP8 input ownership
baseline.denominator: The same-cap frozen installed v127 artifact on the same requests. Later intermediate wins do not reset the 25%/50% goal denominator. Non-MTP may remain contextual reporting but is not this goal denominator.
baseline.draft_policy: Compiled caps 2 and 3 with retained output-tail-v119, confidence 0.4 and eos-frontier-v122. Cap 3 is an upper bound, not three proposals in every round; this diagnostic does not change policy.

planning_budget.interpretation: The current installed verifier interval is about 90%-91% of Decode. At unchanged proposal policy, round count and non-verification costs, 25%/50% total gains require approximately 22%/37% verifier-time reductions. These arithmetic requirements are neither measured candidate gains nor hardware feasibility bounds.
planning_budget.target_rate_authority: TPS values multiply the frozen historical joint medians for planning. Final speedup is established by matched independent-process comparison against the same frozen artifact, not by profiler elapsed time or choosing a favorable historical sample.

invariants.numerical: Preserve exact target finite-precision expressions, FP32 accumulation/reduction order, scale placement, BF16 publication, nonfinite handling, causal attention and all committed recurrent states; private draft approximations retain their existing independent reference qualification.
invariants.state: Preserve complete prefix KV/Conv/GDN/hidden/full logits and matching position at every observer. v127 typed GDN views must follow selected storage and be reacquired after commit/reset. Abort poisons; successful full reset is required before reuse; fatal service recovery remains fresh-process restart.
invariants.runtime: No request-time allocations, hidden fallback, route ambiguity, checkpoint mutation, production cuBLASLt, new exported MTP C++ ABI or weakening of sealed fixed-cap package boundaries.
invariants.reporting: Each measured request reports prompt/output counts, pure Prefill seconds and tokens/s including draft initialization, external TTFT, committed Decode tokens/s and external complete-request time; label diagnostic and ordinary timings separately.

prefill_guard.comparison: Candidate versus same-cap frozen v127 in each identical bucket using matched independent-process repetitions; no averaging away one failing bucket. This goal-specific 2% guard is stricter than the old completed package 3% guard and does not rewrite it.
prefill_guard.scope: Prefill remains measured regression guard; no Prefill optimization campaign is activated.

numerical_reference_chain: Corrected native numerical class: independently qualified FP32 GDN and same-input FP64 Attention; old Legacy BF16 is not model truth.
Same-input scalar full-state/full-logit prefix oracle qualifies exact target verification; complete draftKV is independently replayed.
v127 integration and ownership lifecycle records plus identity-only clean packaging source bridge.

Exact installedv127 full generated-token IDs and complete API text/usage/finish/DONE are the immediate new-candidate comparison. Historical native outputIDs are unavailable; do not claim direct native-ID equality.

first_action.question: On the exact installed v127 cap 3 real API, which target projection, Attention, recurrence, copy or coordination budgets can support a material complete-Decode architecture? Reconcile historical family attribution to the actual current executor.
first_action.capture: One fresh ordinary installed cap 3 server under Nsight Systems node-level CUDA Graph tracing; two bounded request captures, short then 40K, through the ordinary completions API. No runtime source/kernel patch or build substitution. Retain startup and full request/response/witness records.
first_action.sampling: No warmup and no duplicate performance requests or NCU replay. Record profiler version, exact command, trace windows, script hashes and source/ELF identity. Missing first-proposal/entry or other capture coverage is explicit and cannot become a whole-Decode bound.
first_action.oracle: Both full responses and generated tokenIDs must match same-cap installed baseline, as must proposal/acceptance/round/verification/GDN-owner and other non-timing work counts and route receipts.
first_action.environment: Before the fresh process record tegrastats, CPU/process and GPU-handle ownership; quiesce only identified interference, preserve control/recovery paths, run sync and attempt cache drop with before/after memory. Sanitize incidental fan fields and never inspect or control cooling. Through 85C is normal; 85-90C alone is not a veto; use actual clocks, throttle and over-current context. Above 90C, unknown GPU ownership, material contention or resource/device failure stops. No strict 85C selection gate is inherited from old evidence.
outputs: Per-request target projection/GateUp/Down/Attention/GDN/Conv/copy/host intervals with precise coverage and call counts
Full output/work identity comparison and cleanup record
One architecture selection or explicit mechanism rejection tied to current whole-API budget
first_action.stop: After these two captures and their analysis, close profiling and implement a named mathematically specified composition or reject a materially unsupported mechanism. No repeated profile/parameter scan or evidence-only continuation. Harness failure remains failed evidence; any replacement requires a causal record rather than an automatic favorable retry.

preflight_material_contention.cpu_percent_basis: 100% is one CPU core; active collaboration/SSH/evidence/recovery control processes retain their explicit protected role and are not quiesced.
preflight_material_contention.foreign_gpu_handle: Any unowned GPU device handle remains a hard stop, independent of utilization.
preflight_material_contention.strict_collector_cpu_5pct: Supporting observation only for this bounded diagnostic; do not inherit a blanket 5%-CPU rejection.
preflight_material_contention.cache_drop_failure: Retain failure and memory state; no cold-cache claim. This alone does not invalidate unchanged-output node attribution.

required_before_mutation: Named candidate and exact changed expression/operand/state ownership
Numerical equivalence ledger and exact oracle
Current measured budget and conservative upward transfer to real API
Finite implementation/correction budget and immediate composition/API return point
architecture_activation.proven_paths: Study the relevant pinned vLLM/Marlin, FlashInfer, Triton, FLA and Mamba dataflows for the selected boundary; translate mathematical ownership separately from unavailable ISA, preserving license/provenance. Existing known implementations do not authorize numerical reassociation.
architecture_activation.minimal_admission: For a verifier-projection-only change, complete changed-role/shape output and applicable bounds/Graph checks, then existing P65 M1..4 complete prefix state/full logits/draftKV and rejection/EOS/cancel/failure transactions. Add P509 family crossing and P8192 same-history oracle only when Attention/Graph boundary changes; add affected owner/fault checks only for changed ownership. Return promptly to real API rather than running broad qualification before direction.
architecture_activation.API_return: One composed candidate first returns to the representative bucket selected by its measured budget, with short safety check as needed, then both caps across65/16,8192/256,40000/256 for positive direction. A local win cannot replace whole-runner progress.
architecture_activation.negative_direction: Archive/remove a negative complete composition and unused prerequisites; any successor requires a materially different recorded dataflow, not a tile/layout/threshold retry.
architecture_activation.selection: Before architecture or stage selection, freeze a prospective mirrored independent-process protocol using the frozen v127 artifacts and exact candidate(s). Require all six cap/bucket conservative min(candidate Decode)/max(matched baseline Decode) ratios to meet the stage floor and the matched 2% Prefill guard. Preserve failures and all observations; no favorable retry.
architecture_activation.delivery: After positive system selection, qualify affected numerical/API/capacity/capability/lifecycle/resource/installation surfaces on exact sealed deliverables. Reuse unaffected evidence only within its actual artifact/contract scope, then perform explicit requirement-by-requirement final audit.

historical_boundaries.scope: Older shortv113 and longv94-era node times are historical diagnosis only. GDN Graph spans include projections/copies/scheduling, not recurrence alone. Current verify_ms is a complete verifier interval, not pure Attention.

closed_lineages.projection: Current code already shares weight decoding across M2..4, uses K512 input staging and startup FP8 preswizzled ownership. Generic sharing or GateUp fusion is not a new architecture.
closed_lineages.attention: Prior shared-row/row-warp/partitioned producer-consumer PV variants have closed negative API results; stock online-softmax or split reductions are not automatically scalar-equivalent.
closed_lineages.expanded_qkv: docs/metadata/qwen36-27b-mtp-expanded-qkv-assessment-2026-10-10.json already assessed48QKV BF16 expansion. It fit capacity but failed an optimistic traffic/budget screen. New startup allocation alone does not remove doubled traffic or justify recycling this direction.

additional_closed: Private PV splitting, complete private-step Graph and A/B batching cannot be recycled as the primary material speedup hypothesis.
Simple GateUp fusion, shared-row/row-warp/partitioned-producer PV, existing M2..4 weight reuse/K512 ring/FP8 preswizzle are not new mechanisms.
Removing probability storage or adding BF16 weight storage does not prove a whole-path gain or finite-precision equivalence.

rollback: Preserve both frozen installed v127 packages and ordinary non-MTP 0.8.2 unchanged; new runtime composition remains separately identified until its own selection and delivery.
